summary: Iteration 35 scope (file named iteration_34.json as next free slot after iteration_33.json): tested the three new Loyalty features — editable bot message templates (start/welcome/invite) in API + admin UI, and the new reply-keyboard buttons ('Баланс', 'Пригласить друга', 'Моя карта') in the Telegram loyalty bot. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter35_loyalty_bot_messages.py (13 tests, all pass) covering GET defaults, PUT persistence (full + partial), auth guard, and in-process handle_update with Telegram sendMessage/sendPhoto stubbed via monkeypatch. Frontend: superadmin login -> /admin/loyalty -> 'Настройки' tab -> 'Сообщения бота' card with 3 textareas edited, saved (toast 'Настройки сохранены'), page reloaded and all three values persisted exactly. All test data reverted (config fields unset back to defaults, temp bot token/username and QA client removed).

minor.issue: Not a new-feature bug: previous iteration's test test_iter34_loyalty_bot_and_columns.py now fails (4/8) because loyalty_clients for the test restaurant is empty (0 docs) — the seeded clients 'Иван Иванов'/'Мария Петрова'/'Без данных' no longer exist, so birthday/sex column tests and the /birthday-/gender dialog tests (chat_id 333) have no fixture data. Either re-seed those clients or make the iter34 test self-seeding.

No validation of placeholders in the message templates. If an admin types any other braces (e.g. '{balance}' or a literal '{'), str.format() raises and the bot silently falls back to sending the raw un-substituted template (so '{name}'/'{bot_link}' would be shown verbatim to the client). Consider validating allowed placeholders on save or using safe substitution.

issues: Cosmetic: helper text uses <code className="mx-1"> inline right after/before words, rendering as 'Используйте {name}для имени и {bot_link}для ссылки' — missing space before 'для' in both places.

action_items: Optional: add a space (or move the code tag inside the sentence) in the 'Сообщения бота' helper text so it reads '{name} для имени' / '{bot_link} для ссылки'.
Optional: validate/whitelist placeholders on PUT loyalty/config (or use safe formatting) so a bad brace doesn't make the bot send the raw template.

Re-seed loyalty_clients demo data (Иван Иванов / Мария Петрова / Без данных, chat_id 333) or update /app/backend/tests/test_iter34_loyalty_bot_and_columns.py to seed its own fixtures — it currently fails only due to missing data.
critical_code_review_comments: loyalty_bot._norm strips only 💰/👥/🎫 emojis; any future keyboard emoji must be added there too — a lookup table of button label -> handler would be more robust than string matching.
/app/frontend/src/pages/LoyaltyPage.jsx is 849 lines — consider splitting the Настройки / Клиенты / Рассылка / Журнал tabs into separate components.
handle_update repeats the same 'find client by telegram_chat_id + reply Сначала поделитесь номером' block 5 times — extract a helper (DRY).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all assertions of the new settings card + persistence passed)

seed_data_creation: Temporary only, all removed: encrypted fake bot token 123456:FAKE_TEST_TOKEN + telegram_bot_username 'qa_test_bot' on loyalty_config of RID aa25189d-…, and a loyalty client 'QA Тестов' (phone 375299998877, chat 555000111, balance 42.5). Config message fields unset again after the run so GET returns defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter35_loyalty_bot_messages.py. It exercises services.loyalty_bot.handle_update IN-PROCESS with monkeypatched _send/send_card_and_pin, which lets you assert exact reply text and reply_markup — prefer this pattern over hitting the /api/loyalty/webhook endpoint (where outbound Telegram calls to a fake token are swallowed and replies are unobservable). test_iter34_loyalty_bot_and_columns.py currently fails 4/8 purely because loyalty_clients is empty for the test restaurant (0 docs) — not a code regression.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found in the three new features. Backend GET returns DEFAULT_START/WELCOME/INVITE when unset, PUT persists partial and full updates, bot matches 'Баланс'/'💰 Баланс'/'Пригласить друга'/'🎫 Моя карта' via the emoji-stripped _norm comparison, /start uses cfg.start_message_text, welcome after contact formats {name}, invite substitutes {bot_link} -> https://t.me/<username> (falls back to 'этому боту' when bot username is unknown, which is the case for this restaurant since no real token is configured).
